quotes.text: Learn how to accept GrabPay, a common payment method in Southeast Asia.
This article has multiple variants. Fetch one of the following URLs to view specific content for your use case:

old_evidence.text: There is no minimum charge amount for GrabPay so the payment amount can be as low as 1.

findings: November new raw lines 5-18 supply only a purpose sentence and five variant links; diff lines 3-11 and 1135-1140 show root-body replacement by an index. This is a navigation capture delta, not proof of changed checkout, mobile or Direct API behavior. Source lines 4-7, 33-35 must retain the May 7 detailed raw and add separate November provenance.

Old May raw lines 8, 20, 26-31 and 53-96 describe single-use GrabPay, no subscriptions/future payments, SG merchant/customer SGD and MY merchant/customer MYR, same-currency one-time Checkout line items, hosted success_url versus embedded return_url. Mobile/Direct API sections at old raw lines 112-116, 360-364, 572-576 and 853-857 carry those paths as dated history. The new index alone does not restate eligibility.

Source line 17 labels 'Four integration paths' but lists five: Checkout, iOS, Android, React Native and Direct API. November index lines 13-18 likewise enumerate five variants. Stripe index line 402 and concept wiki/concepts/stripe-wallets.md line 409 repeat '4 paths + mobile', which is ambiguous and merits reciprocal correction.

Source line 19 and concept wiki/concepts/stripe-wallets.md line 271 interpret old raw lines 215, 438, 656 and 878 'amount can be as low as 1' as '1 SGD/MYR'. The old examples send integer PaymentIntent amount values (old raw lines 222-226); the pinned guide does not spell out one whole currency unit. Preserve 'no minimum; API amount can be 1' as dated wording rather than claim a one-dollar minimum or independently assert its minor-unit equivalent.

Source line 25 and concept line 271 say an iOS custom URL scheme is required; old raw line 247 allows a custom URL scheme OR universal link for iOS app return. React Native separately says universal links are not supported and requires a custom URL (old raw lines 715-725), while the iOS sample uses returnURL and StripeAPI.handleURLCallback (old raw lines 253-298). This is a material cross-platform baseline conflict needing reciprocal warning.

Source lines 27-31 are generally supported by old Android billing name (old raw lines 473-490), React Native confirmPayment/deep link (old raw lines 715-796), and Direct API client confirm plus optional server manual requires_action redirect (old raw lines 982-1016, 1070-1125). PaymentIntent creation, requires_action, browser return, SDK callback or test-page approval are not final payment proof; old raw lines 325-329, 818-822 and 1040-1048 prefer payment_intent.succeeded event for business action.
historical_claims_to_preserve: Retain May 7 single-use/no recurring, SG/MY merchant-customer currency pairing and Checkout one-time same-currency conditions (old raw lines 8, 20, 26-31).

Retain dated iOS/Android/React Native SDK examples, Stripe.js dahlia Direct API sample, SG/MY transaction-limit links and test redirect as historical evidence (old raw lines 137-215, 245-323, 351-358, 401-490, 563-570, 715-796, 963-1042, 1127-1134).
Keep client secret, return_url/query parameter and optional server-side manual redirect/state boundaries scoped to Direct API (old raw lines 892-894, 982-1016, 1070-1125).
conflicts: Source line 25 and wiki/concepts/stripe-wallets.md line 271 overstate iOS custom URL scheme as required; old raw line 247 permits custom URL scheme or universal link. React Native old raw lines 715-725 has the stricter custom-scheme requirement.
Source line 17 lists five paths under 'Four'; wiki/stripe-index.md line 402 and concept line 409 repeat '4 paths + mobile' despite five listed/new raw links (new raw lines 13-18).

Source line 19 and concept line 271 turn old raw 'amount as low as 1' (old raw lines 215, 438, 656, 878) into ambiguous '1 SGD/MYR'; do not imply a whole-currency minimum from integer API amount text.
unresolved_questions: The five November variant URLs at new raw lines 13-18 were not captured in the pinned order; their November prerequisites, mobile SDK behavior, current transaction limits and outcome handling remain unverified.

findings: Add November root-index raw provenance without replacing May detailed guide (source lines 4-7, 33-35; new raw lines 9-18).
Correct five-versus-four path count at source line 17 against its own list and new raw lines 13-18.

Qualify no-minimum/API amount wording at source line 19 against old raw lines 215, 438, 656, 878; correct iOS custom-scheme-only wording at source line 25 against old raw line 247 while retaining React Native custom-scheme condition at old raw lines 715-725.
Keep SG/MY eligibility, Checkout line-item, Direct API requires_action and payment_intent.succeeded event bounds dated (old raw lines 26-31, 1070-1125, 1044-1048).
conflicts: iOS custom URL scheme claim excludes the old guide's universal-link alternative.
One-unit API amount wording was expanded into an ambiguous whole-currency claim.
source_assessments.reason: The November raw delta is navigation only, but this mapped source needs provenance plus baseline path-count, iOS return-route and amount-wording corrections; corresponding index/concept claims need reciprocal attention.

answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/grabpay/accept-a-payment, the complete November capture (new raw lines 5-18) says GrabPay is a Southeast Asian payment method and links Checkout, Direct API, iOS, Android and React Native; it specifies no current transaction rule or success state. The May guide (old raw lines 8-31, 53-96, 209-231, 982-1016, 1044-1048, 1070-1125) documents single-use authorization, no future/subscription payments, SG/SGD and MY/MYR merchant-customer pairing, one-time same-currency Checkout Sessions, server PaymentIntent/client secret, and redirect confirmation that requires a separate successful outcome signal. source-stripe-grabpay-accept-payment.md summarizes paths but miscounts five as four, overstates an iOS custom URL scheme requirement, and turns the API amount '1' into ambiguous whole-currency wording.
answers.Q2: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/grabpay/accept-a-payment, the November difference is a navigation-only root index (new raw lines 9-18 versus old raw lines 8-1134), not a proven substantive change or deprecation of May variants. source-stripe-grabpay-accept-payment.md should retain May-dated SG/MY, Checkout, SDK, Direct API and test claims and add November provenance. Correct its five-versus-four count and warn reciprocally in the Stripe index/concept; old raw line 247 allows iOS custom scheme or universal link while old raw lines 715-725 require a custom URL for React Native, contrary to the source/concept's uniform wording. Old raw lines 215, 438, 656 and 878 say integer API amount as low as 1, not an explicit whole SGD/MYR minimum. A created PaymentIntent, requires_action redirect, browser return or test approval is not payment success; payment_intent.succeeded events are the old guide's business-action boundary (old raw lines 1040-1048).
